concerns.text: FR-007 states: "System MUST perform a paired t-test on prediction errors between the GNN and the Random Forest baseline (trained on graph-derived features only) to assess statistical significance." This contradicts FR-005 (Random Forest baseline using standard descriptors) and FR-012 (ablation study using graph-derived features only). Comparing a GNN to a Random Forest that also uses graph-derived features makes the validation circular: the claimed advantage of graph‑based representations over "strictly non‑topological" baselines cannot be demonstrated because both models receive the same topological inputs. The validation target (model performance) is therefore not independent of the predictor set, violating the core research question and constituting a science‑level flaw.
